title: 第11章 2-0轻取VG
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

第二局BP刚开始，VG的针对意图就已经赤裸裸地写在了公屏上。

卡牌直接被按死。

紧接着，冰女也一起被送上了Ban位。

VG的意思很明确：他们不想再看到那种“全地图都是Tree”的窒息比赛。

蓝色方LGD的阵容锁得极快：

上单：奎因

打野：千珏

中单：泰坦

下路：轮子妈+巨魔

而VG则拿到了船长、豹女、瑞兹、EZ加布隆的传统发育阵容，依旧是瑞兹加豹女的中野组合。

“中单泰坦？！”娃娃的声音猛地拔高，“上一场蛇队和OMG的比赛，Tank选手才拿出了中单泰坦，这也是本赛季第一场中单泰坦。”

“对阵的是无状态的冰女，但那场比赛是输了。”

“结果Tree又拿出了中单泰坦？”

“Tank那把效果并不好啊。”

2016年的英雄联盟，中单生态依然崇尚法核与刺客，泰坦这种纯重装坦克去打双C之一的中单位，绝对属于离经叛道。

米勒反应极快：“不，LGD这把的思路太清晰了，就是极致的快节奏强开。尤其是奎因和泰坦这两个点，VG的边路会非常难受。”

比赛进行到四分钟。

中路泰坦凭借极快的推线效率，在清完线后再度消失。

VG的下路双人组此时正被死死压在塔下，虽然注意到了泰坦的消失，但他们并没太当回事，毕竟一个区区四级的泰坦连大招都没有，根本不具备越塔强杀的质变能力。

然而，他们都太低估了泰坦的控制和坦度。

“平队，你和imp快推线，我和艾米准备来下路打四包二。”陈周指挥道。

先指挥艾米的刷野路线，再指挥下路的节奏，陈周此刻已然掌握这只老干爹的指挥权。

下路的imp和PYL在陈周的指挥下展现出了远超平时的侵略性。

轮子妈和巨魔哪怕顶着被消耗的风险，也强行把大批小兵往VG的防御塔里塞。

这种反常的激进推进，瞬间突破了VG下路的心理防线。

就在辅助小段的布隆打算去做眼的时候，泰坦和千珏已经出现了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as the second round of BP started, VG's intentions were clearly written on the public screen.

The card was directly pressed to death.

Immediately afterwards, the ice girl was also sent to class.

VG's meaning is clear: they don't want to see that kind of suffocating game where "the whole map is Tree".

The blue side LGD’s lineup was locked very quickly:

Top order: Quinn

Jungler: Kindred

Mid laner: Titan

Bottom lane: Wheel Mom + Troll

VG got the traditional development lineup of Captain, Leopard Girl, Ryze, and EZ Gablon. It is still the midfielder combination of Ryze and Leopard Girl.

"Mid Titan?!" Wawa's voice suddenly rose, "In the last game between the Snakes and OMG, Tank player took out the Mid Titan. This is also the first Mid Titan in this season."

“It was against the ice girls who were out of form, but we lost that game.”

"In the end, Tree took out the mid laner Titan again?"

"The effect of Tank is not very good."

In League of Legends in 2016, the mid lane ecology still advocates magic cores and assassins. It is absolutely deviant for a pure heavy tank like Titan to play one of the double C mid units.

Miller reacted very quickly: "No, LGD's thinking is too clear, it is the ultimate fast-paced force. Especially the two points of Quinn and Titan, VG's wing will be very uncomfortable."

Four minutes into the game.

The Titan in the middle relied on its extremely fast line pushing efficiency and disappeared again after clearing the line.

VG's bottom lane duo was being pinned under the tower at this time. Although they noticed the Titan's disappearance, they didn't take it too seriously. After all, a mere level 4 Titan didn't even have a big move and didn't have the ability to jump over the tower and kill.

However, they all underestimated Titan's control and openness.

"Ping team, you and imp push the lane quickly, Amy and I are going to come to the bottom lane to play four-for-two." Chen Zhou directed.

First directing Amy's jungle route, and then directing the rhythm of the bottom lane, Chen Zhou now has the command of this old godfather.

Imp and PYL in the bottom lane showed far more aggression than usual under Chen Zhou's command.

Even at the risk of being consumed, the Wheel Mom and the Troll forced a large number of minions into VG's defense tower.

This abnormally aggressive advance instantly broke through VG's psychological defense line in the bottom lane.

Just when Braum, who was assisting Xiao Duan, was about to do his eyes, Titan and Kindred had already appeared.
